Hi all, I'm interested in formalizing parts of the theory of minimal surfaces with compact support and fixed boundary conditions in Lean 4 / Mathlib, and wanted to check whether anyone is already working in this area before starting. Concretely, I'm thinking about:

• The first variation formula (vanishing mean curvature as the Euler–Lagrange condition for the area functional)
• The second variation formula (the stability operator / Jacobi operator)
• Stability — non-negativity of the second variation and its relationship to the index

@Heather Macbeth , @Patrick Massot and I are working towards defining curvature (of Riemannian manifolds, see #36036 and friends for the current state). I'm also supervising a master's student working in this area --- depending on what exactly you'd like to do, there may or may not be overlap.
I'm not aware of projects in variational calculus specifically.
